4423007102.descriptionHtml:
Jitterbit automates and orchestrates business systems to empower teams, unlock value, and accelerate business transformation. With Jitterbit, organizations can streamline operations, enhance data accessibility, and deliver on a growing list of IT needs more quickly and confidently.

For organizations ready to modernize and innovate, Jitterbit provides a unified AI-infused low-code platform for integration, orchestration, automation, and app development that accelerates business transformation, boosts productivity, and unlocks value. The Jitterbit Harmony platform, including iPaaS, API Manager, App Builder and EDI, future-proofs operations, simplifies complexity and drives innovation for organizations globally.



Job Description

About the team:

At Jitterbit, engineering is at the heart of everything we do. We take pride in writing high-quality, maintainable code and delivering a world-class user experience. Our team is collaborative, driven, and embraces a remote-first culture designed for productivity and innovation.

You’ll work closely with engineers, product managers, and operations to push the boundaries of what’s possible in enterprise integration. We value curiosity, ownership, and continuous learning.

About the role:

As a Senior Backend Engineer, you’ll play a key role in designing and developing new features for our iPaaS and APIM platform. You'll work with a modern and diverse tech stack, including:

  • Languages & Frameworks: Java, C++, Lua
  • Infrastructure & DevOps: Docker, Kubernetes, Linux, Nginx, Tomcat, Apache
  • Data & Messaging: MySQL, SQL Server, Redis, Kafka, Elasticsearch, InfluxDB
  • Cloud Services: AWS (S3, CloudFront, DynamoDB)

You’ll take ownership of projects from design through deployment, ensuring scalability, reliability, and performance in a 24x7x365 environment. This is a high-impact role offering the opportunity to work on cutting-edge technologies and help shape the future of integration and automation.

About you:

You are an engineer who can turn ideas into extremely reliable and scalable designs. You code in such a way that other engineers find your code easy to comprehend, modify, and build upon. You believe in the power of Integration and APIs to transform how systems are integrated and how applications are built.

You will be successful in this role if you:

  • Enjoy helping and mentoring others around you as you grow and become a successful engineer and developer
  • Have excellent written and verbal communication skills
  • Are capable of working in a distributed team and able to excel in a remote culture
  • Are self-driven and able to work on key initiatives
  • Take pleasure in making things happen and listen to the input from peers
  • Are able to make data driven decisions
  • Are a believer in a best idea strategy regardless of where or who ideas come from

Qualifications

We are looking for:

  • 10+ years of experience in building large scale distributed applications.
  • Strong experience building multi-tenant SaaS applications
  • Strong problem-solving, debugging, and analytical skills with great attention to detail
  • Experience with Microservices and Cloud-based architectures/design patterns

Technical Skills and Experience:

  • Strong Experience in Java
  • Substantial experience with top tier RDBMS such as SQL Server and MySQL
  • Excellent JavaScript, CSS and HTML authoring skills.
  • Proficiency with Javascript, TypeScript, Java Node.js, or Go.
  • Familiar with application deployment via Docker and/or Kubernetes.
  • Hands-on experience with AWS services such as DynamoDB, S3, or CloudFront.

Additional Information

What You’ll Get:

  • Work for a growing leader within the Integration Platform as a Service (iPaaS) tech space
  • Join a mission-driven company that is transforming the industry by changing the way customers use API creation within business-critical processes.
  • Career development and mentorship
  • A flexible, remote-friendly company with personality and heart



Jitterbit is an Equal Opportunity Employer. Employment decisions are made without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, age, physical or mental disability, genetic factors, military/veteran status or other characteristics protected by law.

Application and Interview Impersonation Notice:  Impersonating another individual when applying for employment, and/or participating in an interview process to assist another individual in obtaining employment, with Precisely Software Incorporated (“Precisely”) is unlawful.  If Precisely identifies such fraudulent conduct, then as applicable and to the extent permitted by law, the application will be rejected, an offer (if made) will be rescinded, or the employment will be terminated, and legal action may be taken against the impersonators.

Precisely is the leader in data integrity. We empower businesses to make more confident decisions based on trusted data through a unique combination of software, data enrichment products and strategic services. What does this mean to you? For starters, it means joining a company focused on delivering outstanding innovation and support that helps customers increase revenue, lower costs and reduce risk. In fact, Precisely powers better decisions for more than 12,000 global organizations, including 95 of the Fortune 100. Precisely's 2500 employees are unified by four company core values that are central to who we are and how we operate: Openness, Determination, Individuality, and Collaboration. We are committed to career development for our employees and offer opportunities for growth, learning and building community. With a "work from anywhere" culture, we celebrate diversity in a distributed environment with a presence in 30 countries as well as 20 offices in over 5 continents. Learn more about why it's an exciting time to join Precisely!

Precisely is an AI-first organization. All employees are expected to demonstrate proficiency in applying AI tools to accelerate their work, improve output quality, and eliminate low-value tasks. Candidates should be comfortable using generative AI tools (e.g., Microsoft Copilot, ChatGPT) in their day-to-day workflows, able to evaluate AI-generated outputs critically, and open to continuously adopting new AI capabilities as they emerge.

 

Overview:

The role will be responsible for translating product strategy and business priorities into a coherent set of features for one or more scrum teams. Take on multiple roles including Feature lead, Developer, product designer, QA, and project manager. Key member of the team strategizing and presenting the future vision of the product to business and technology stakeholders in collaboration with the Product Manager.

What you will do:

  • Execute the product vision, roadmap, and growth opportunities.
  • Helps conduct market and competitive analysis, defines products to serve those needs, the addressable market, ability to penetrate and sell, and overall business justification and strategic fit for products.
  • Help execute the value proposition and business case.
  • Provides team leadership through communication and coordination of cross functional teams at all levels of the organization.
  • Leads architecture for all components in an investment segment. May focus on one component but must have expertise across all components.
  • Responsible for design of systems in the investment segment.
  • Actively supports Product Manager in the Product Planning, business performance of one or more products.
  • Engage with customers throughout the product lifecycle to better glean product insights.
  • Understand requirements that comes from stakeholders and helps turn them into consumable backlog items for the team.
  • Write clear, compelling, and detailed (technical) user epics and stories with user acceptance criteria. Participate in story grooming exercises for crisp and unambiguous documentation and communication of features to be developed.
  • Ensure the backlog is prioritized in order before the sprint.
  • Coordinate with appropriate architects to ensure tech decisions are made and implemented. Also Identifying business process improvements and opportunities for automation.
  • Work with the Product Manager and Engineering Leader to propose percentage of effort for different types of value in each release.
  • Participates in technical and sales enablement.

What we are looking for:

  •  Bachelor’s Degree (or higher) in business or technical field.
  •  8+ years of industry experience in the areas of data engineering and product management. 
  • Expertise in Java for backend development.
  • Expertise with databases, particularly Mongo Atlas, and developing/consuming REST APIs.
  • Track record of Designing and developing data products or software products.
  • Exposure to cloud-native technologies including Docker, Kubernetes, Kafka, and microservices architecture is a must. 
  • Basic understanding of agile and scrum methodologies is a must.  
  • Experience of AWS/Azure/GCP, Redis, Security Domain, Datadog, Code fresh
  • Working knowledge of data ETL will be preferred.
  • Experience with data visualization tools such as Tableau, Power BI etc.
  • Ability to communicate with various stakeholders at all levels of the organization.
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
  • Excellent interpersonal skills and active listener.
  • Able to set and meet time-sensitive goals.
  • Able to handle multiple tasks simultaneously and adapt to change while providing structure to operations and go-to-market teams.

AI Skills/Knowledge:

  • AI-assisted development: Experience using tools such as GitHub Copilot and Cursor to support coding, code review, documentation, and test generation.
  • LLM and agentic workflows: Familiarity with LLM APIs and agent-based workflows, with the ability to apply them thoughtfully in software engineering use cases.
  • Responsible AI practices: Understanding of responsible AI principles, including bias mitigation, security considerations, explainability, and appropriate use of AI-generated outputs.

Preferred Skills (a plus but not required):

  • Familiarity with frontend scripting languages such as Node.js and React.js
  • Understanding of spark framework along with Snowflake and Databricks.
  • Hands on Terraform will be advantageous.

The personal data that you provide as a part of this job application will be handled in accordance with relevant laws. For more information about how Precisely handles the personal data of job applicants, please see the Precisely Candidate Privacy Notice

Job Description: Full Stack Developer (Java + React)

Experience- 4+ years

Location- Chennai/Remote

Employment Type: Full-Time


About the Role

We are looking for a highly motivated Full Stack Developer with expertise in Java and React to join our engineering team. The candidate will be responsible for building scalable backend services and responsive frontend applications, contributing to the complete software development lifecycle.


Key Responsibilities

  • Design, develop, and maintain end-to-end web applications

  • Work in Agile/Scrum environment


Required Skills

  • Strong experience in Java (8+), Spring Boot, Spring MVC, and Microservices
  • Hands-on experience in React.js, JavaScript (ES6+), HTML5, CSS3
  • Experience in REST API development and integration
  • Knowledge of Hibernate/JPA and ORM frameworks
  • Strong understanding of SQL databases (MySQL, PostgreSQL, Oracle)
  • Basic knowledge of NoSQL databases (MongoDB preferred)
  • Experience with state management (Redux/Context API)
  • Familiarity with UI frameworks (Material UI, Bootstrap)
  • Experience with version control tools (Git)
  • Knowledge of CI/CD pipelines
  • Exposure to cloud platforms (AWS/GCP/Azure)
  • Basic understanding of Docker/Kubernetes

4424676269.descriptionHtml:
Summary

 Position Summary

Artificial Intelligence & Engineering

AI & Engineering leverages  cutting-edge  engineering capabilities to help build, deploy, and  operate  integrated/verticalized sector solutions in software, data, AI, network, and hybrid cloud infrastructure. These insights are powered by engineering for business advantage, helping transform mission-critical operations. 

Join our AI & Engineering team to help transform technology platforms,  driving  innovation, and help make a significant impact on our clients' achievements.  You’ll  work alongside talented  professionals  reimagining and re-engineering operations and processes that could be critical to businesses. 

Position Summary

Level: Software Engineer II

As a Software Engineer II at Deloitte Consulting, you will deliver backend and front-end engineering solutions that support enterprise-scale applications and client transformations. You will apply experience in Java, Spring Boot, and Angular to build maintainable, secure, and scalable solutions while contributing to delivery quality, process improvement, and innovation. This role offers the opportunity to work across modern engineering practices, strengthen technical depth, and support high-quality outcomes in a collaborative environment.

Work you'll do

As a Software Engineer II on the Engineering as a Service team, you will be responsible for …

  • Designing, developing, and maintaining backend services and application programming interfaces using Java, Spring, Spring Boot, and microservices architecture
  • Building and enhancing Angular applications using TypeScript, reactive programming patterns, and integration with RESTful services
  • Supporting solution design decisions by evaluating technical approaches, identifying risks, and contributing to secure, maintainable, and performant implementations
  • Performing testing, debugging, defect management, documentation, and production issue resolution across the software development lifecycle
  • Contributing to process improvements, automation, delivery metric tracking, knowledge sharing, and development of tools or accelerators that improve project outcomes

The Team

Engineering as a Service provides complete design, implementation, and technology operations, leveraging our core engineering expertise . We transform engineering teams, modernize technology, and deliver complex programs with a product engineering approach. Our flexible delivery models—traditional teams, pools, or pods—are tailored to each client’s needs, offering engineering-led advisory, implementation, and operational capabilities to accelerate innovation.

Education: BE/ B.Tech /M.C.A./ M.Sc (CS) degree or equivalent from accredited university

Location: Bengaluru, Hyderabad, Chennai, Pune

Shift Timings: 11 AM to 8 PM or 2 PM to 11 PM IST

Qualifications

Must Have Skills/Project Experience/Certifications:

  • Core JAVA & Backend engineering
  • 4 - 7 years of strong hands-on experience in JAVA( 8 +) with solid grounding in Object-Oriented design principles and clean coding practices including identifying design flaws in existing codebases and refactoring towards maintainable designs
  • Well versed with core Java concepts including Exception Handling, Collections Framework, Concurrency (threads), Streams, Lambdas etc.
  • Ability to design and implement efficient, Secure , and maintainable backend code, evaluate multiple solution approaches, and justify design decisions considering performance and security trade-offs
  • Spring & Enterprise Frameworks:
  • Strong understanding of microservices architecture , with the ability able to design high-level service boundaries, ensure effective inter-service communication and manage data consistency
  • Hands-on experience building and maintaining RESTful APIs using Spring Boot, applying API design best practices and integrating with external services, data sources and databases
  • Solid expertise in Spring framework/Spring Boot design principles including core annotations, dependency injection, bean lifecycle, transaction management, and database access patterns.
  • Experience implementing security and cloud-native patterns using Spring Security and Spring Cloud ( e.g. authentication/ authorization, configuration and resiliency)
  • Strong understanding of data persistence , including RDBMS & SQL (or NOSQL), normalization , complex query troubleshooting and ORM/ JPA (e.g., Hibernate) for performant and transactional data access.
  • Proven ability in testing, trouble shooting and debugging , including writing JUnit tests, identifying performance bottlenecks, and resolving production issues with minimal handholding
  • Angular
  • 4 - 7 years of hands-on experience in Angular
  • Strong hands-on experience building scalable and production-grade angular applications using TypeScript and modern JavaScript (ES6+).
  • Strong understanding of Angular fundamentals, including components , modules , services , dependency injection (DI) , routing , guards, and forms (template / reactive - driven).
  • Proficiency with RxJS and reactive programming, including observables , operators , subscription management and effective error handling patterns.
  • Experience implementing state management patterns ( e.g. , NgRx or equivalent), including separation of UI state vs domain state
  • Strong UI engineering fundamentals including HTML/ CSS, responsive design, accessibility considerations and cross-browser compatibility
  • Hands-on experience integrating Angular applications with backend services via RESTful APIs ( GraphQL where applicable ) , including contract-driven integration ( OpenAPI /Swagger), pagination, error handling
  • Experience implementing authentication and authorization flows in the UI using OAuth2/OIDC and JWT, including interceptors, route guards, and role-based UI behavior.
  • Strong testing & Debugging skills with unit tests (Jasmine/Karma/Jest) and end-to-end automation (Playwright/Cypress), ensuring stability and maintainability.
  • Experience with Angular performance optimization, including lazy loading, change detection strategies, efficient rendering, and bundle optimization
  • Familiarity with Angular CLI, environment configuration, build pipelines, and deployment optimization
  • Soft Skills
  • Strong communication skills with the ability to articulate technical concepts clearly to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
  • Proven experience working directly with clients and business stakeholders to clarify requirements, manage expectations, and reduce ambiguity.
  • Ability to ask the right questions, challenge assumptions constructively, and drive clarity in complex or evolving problem spaces.
  • Strong collaboration mindset; able to work effectively with cross-functional teams including product managers, designers, QA, and platform teams.
  • Ownership-driven approach with the ability to independently drive tasks to completion with minimal handholding

Good to Have Skills/Project Experience/Certifications:

  • Certification (JAVA):
  • Oracle Certified Associate (Java 8 or above)
  • Oracle Certified Professional (preferred but not mandatory)
  • Agile Development and Collaboration
  • Experience working in Agile/Scrum or SAFe environments with iterative delivery and continuous feedback.
  • Ability to collaborate effectively with product, QA, and platform teams to deliver high-quality features incrementally.
  • Comfortable participating in sprint planning, estimations, reviews, and retrospectives with a delivery-oriented mindset
  • Awareness of any of the industry domains

4446791357.descriptionHtml:
Job Description:

About The Role

We're seeking a Senior Java Developer with 5+ years' experience to build high-performing, scalable enterprise portal backends, APIs, and modern React frontends. You'll develop modular services, cloud-native integrations, and headless APIs for robust, production-ready portal applications.

Key Responsibilities

  • Develop modular Java backend services (OSGi modules, Service Builder equivalents) and RESTful/GraphQL headless APIs for enterprise portals.
  • Build responsive React frontends with client extensions consuming portal APIs and state management (Redux/Zustand).
  • Design and optimize Postgres/MySQL databases with advanced entity-service mappings and SQL performance tuning.
  • Implement event-driven integrations using message brokers (RabbitMQ, Kafka, Azure Service Bus) for cross-module communication.
  • Deploy containerized portal applications with Docker/Kubernetes on Azure, ensuring high availability.
  • Optimize performance with distributed caching (Redis, Hazelcast), low-latency APIs, and frontend bundle optimization.
  • Collaborate across full SDLC: API contracts, modular development, frontend integration, deployment, and monitoring.
  • Implement full-stack observability with Prometheus, Grafana, Datadog across backend services and frontend.
  • Implement DevSecOps with automated security scanning, CI/CD pipelines for modular deployments.

Must-Have Skills

  • Backend/Portal: Java 17+, Spring Boot, enterprise portal frameworks (OSGi modules, Service Builder, modular service layers); REST/GraphQL headless APIs.
  • Frontend: React 18+, TypeScript, hooks, component libraries (Material-UI), portal client extensions/API integration.
  • Architecture: Microservices/modular monoliths, design patterns (CQRS, Event Sourcing, repository patterns).
  • Agentic Coding: Proficiency with agentic AI coding assistants for rapid prototyping, refactoring complex OSGi modules, and generating tests across full-stack components.
  • DevOps/CI-CD: Docker, Kubernetes (Helm charts), Jenkins/GitHub Actions, multi-module pipelines.
  • Cloud: Azure (2+ years hands-on).
  • Databases: Postgres/MySQL, JPA/Hibernate, advanced SQL, entity-service mappings.
  • Testing: JUnit/Mockito (backend), Jest/React Testing Library (frontend), integration testing.
  • Tools: Git, Gradle/Maven (multi-module), npm/yarn.
  • Full SDLC experience; OWASP security for enterprise applications.

Nice-to-Have Skills

  • Kafka streaming, Next.js for portal frontends.
  • Infrastructure as Code (Terraform for portal deployments).
  • Advanced monitoring: Datadog, Splunk.
  • Domain-Driven Design, legacy system integration (.NET/mainframes).
  • Portal-specific patterns: content management, user personalization, workflow engines.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Bachelor's/Master’s in computer science.
  • Cloud/Java certifications.

Business Overview

BNP Paribas is a leading global banking group with a strong diversified and integrated model. We provide a wide range of financial services to individuals, community associations, entrepreneurs, SMEs, corporates, and institutional clients. Our technology teams are at the heart of our digital transformation, building robust, scalable, and secure applications that power international banking operations and enhance client experiences across the globe.


Position Purpose

We are seeking a skilled and motivated Backend Developer - Java to join our engineering team. The successful candidate will be responsible for designing, developing, and maintaining end-to-end software solutions. You will work in an Agile environment, collaborating with cross-functional teams to deliver high-quality code that aligns with the Group’s architecture guidelines and business objectives.


Job Responsibilities

  • Design, develop, and implement scalable backend applications using Java with a deep understanding of Core Java concepts (Collections, Multithreading, Streams API).
  • Translate functional requirements and business needs into detailed technical specifications and architecture designs.
  • Write clean, maintainable, and efficient code. Perform unit testing, integration testing, and participate in peer code reviews to ensure high standards of quality.
  • Identify, troubleshoot, and resolve software defects and performance bottlenecks in production and non-production environments.
  • Actively participate in all Agile ceremonies (Sprint Planning, Daily Stand-ups, Retrospectives) and collaborate closely with Business Analysts and Product Owners.
  • Execute (CI/CD) continuous integration and deployment pipelines to ensure a smooth delivery calendar.
  • Stay updated with emerging technology trends and propose improvements to existing systems to enhance scalability and robustness.


Required Qualifications, Capabilities, and Skills

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science/ Information Technology/ Engineering, or a related field with 6+ years applied experience
  • Strong proficiency in Java (Version 11 or higher) with a deep understanding of Core Java concepts (Collections, Multithreading, Streams API).
  • Extensive experience with the Spring Ecosystem (Spring Boot, Spring MVC, Spring Security) and Hibernate.
  • Proficiency in SQL and experience working with relational databases.
  • Experience with testing frameworks such as JUnit and Mockito.
  • Extensive experience with Jenkins, Ansible, or other CI/CD automation tools.


Preferred Qualifications, Capabilities, and Skills

  • Knowledge of modern JavaScript frameworks (e.g., Angular or React).
  • Knowledge in designing and implementing Microservices architecture.
  • Exposure to event-driven architecture and messaging tools such as Apache Kafka or RabbitMQ.
  • Prior experience working within the Banking or Financial Services industry.
  • Strong teamwork skills and the ability to work effectively with global stakeholders.
  • A proactive mindset with the ability to learn new technologies and adapt to changing business requirements.
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills.

Company Overview

Milestone Technologies is a global IT managed services firm that partners with organizations to scale their technology, infrastructure and services to drive specific business outcomes such as digital transformation, innovation, and operational agility. Milestone is focused on building an employee-first, performance-based culture and for over 25 years, we have a demonstrated history of supporting category-defining enterprise clients that are growing ahead of the market. The company specializes in providing solutions across Application Services and Consulting, Digital Product Engineering, Digital Workplace Services, Private Cloud Services, AI/Automation, and ServiceNow. Milestone culture is built to provide a collaborative, inclusive environment that supports employees and empowers them to reach their full potential.

Our seasoned professionals deliver services based on Milestone’s best practices and service delivery framework. By leveraging our vast knowledge base to execute initiatives, we deliver both short-term and long-term value to our clients and apply continuous service improvement to deliver transformational benefits to IT. With Intelligent Automation, Milestone helps businesses further accelerate their IT transformation. The result is a sharper focus on business objectives and a dramatic improvement in employee productivity. Through our key technology partnerships and our people-first approach, Milestone continues to deliver industry-leading innovation to our clients. With more than 3,000 employees serving over 200 companies worldwide, we are following our mission of revolutionizing the way IT is deployed.

Job Overview

Job Summary

We are seeking a highly skilled Senior MuleSoft Developer with 4-8 years of IT experience and strong expertise in designing, developing, and implementing integration solutions using the MuleSoft Anypoint Platform. The ideal candidate should have hands-on experience building APIs, system integrations, application connectivity solutions, and cloud-based integrations while following API-led connectivity principles and best practices.

Key Responsibilities

  • Design, develop, test, deploy, and maintain MuleSoft integration solutions using Mule 4.
  • Build reusable APIs, connectors, and integration services using Anypoint Platform.
  • Implement API-led connectivity architecture including Experience, Process, and System APIs.
  • Develop integrations between cloud and on-premise applications.
  • Create RAML/OpenAPI specifications and API documentation.
  • Configure and manage Anypoint Exchange, API Manager, Runtime Manager, and CloudHub.
  • Troubleshoot performance issues and optimize Mule applications.
  • Participate in architecture discussions, technical design reviews, and code reviews.
  • Implement security standards including OAuth 2.0, JWT, SAML, TLS, and API policies.
  • Work closely with business analysts, architects, QA teams, and stakeholders to deliver integration solutions.
  • Ensure adherence to SDLC, DevOps, CI/CD, and Agile methodologies.
  • Support production deployments, incident management, and root cause analysis.

Required Skills

MuleSoft Expertise

  • Strong hands-on experience with MuleSoft Anypoint Platform.
  • Experience in Mule 4 development.
  • Knowledge of API-led connectivity and microservices architecture.
  • Experience with DataWeave 2.0 transformations.
  • Expertise in RESTful APIs, SOAP Web Services, and integration patterns.
  • Experience with API lifecycle management.

Integration & Middleware

  • Enterprise application integration (EAI).
  • Message Queues and asynchronous integrations.
  • Batch processing and event-driven architectures.
  • Experience integrating ERP, CRM, and SaaS applications.

Cloud & DevOps

  • Experience with CloudHub and Runtime Fabric.
  • Knowledge of CI/CD tools such as Jenkins, GitHub Actions, Azure DevOps, or GitLab.
  • Experience with Git, Maven, and deployment automation.

Database & Messaging

  • SQL and NoSQL databases.
  • Experience with Oracle, SQL Server, PostgreSQL, or MySQL.
  • Messaging platforms such as JMS, Kafka, RabbitMQ, or ActiveMQ.

Security

  • OAuth 2.0
  • OpenID Connect
  • JWT
  • SSL/TLS
  • API Security Best Practices

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor's or Master's Degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or related discipline.
  • 4-8 years of overall IT experience.
  • Minimum 3+ years of hands-on MuleSoft development experience.
  • Experience delivering enterprise-scale integration projects.
  • Strong analytical, debugging, and problem-solving skills.
  • Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.

Preferred Qualifications

  • MuleSoft Certified Developer (MCD - Level 1/Level 2).
  • MuleSoft Certified Integration Architect (preferred).
  • Experience with Salesforce, SAP, Workday, ServiceNow, Oracle, or other enterprise platforms.
  • Exposure to Azure, AWS, or Google Cloud.

Compensation

Estimated Pay Range:

Exact compensation and offers of employment are dependent on circumstances of each case and will be determined based on job-related knowledge, skills, experience, licenses or certifications, and location.

Our Commitment to Diversity & Inclusion

At Milestone we strive to create a workplace that reflects the communities we serve and work with, where we all feel empowered to bring our full, authentic selves to work. We know creating a diverse and inclusive culture that champions equity and belonging is not only the right thing to do for our employees but is also critical to our continued success.

Milestone Technologies provides equal employment opportunity for all applicants and employees. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment and will not be discriminated against on the basis of race, color, religion, gender, gender identity, marital status, age, disability, veteran status, sexual orientation, national origin, or any other category protected by applicable federal and state law, or local ordinance. Milestone also makes reasonable accommodations for disabled applicants and employees. 

We welcome the unique background, culture, experiences, knowledge, innovation, self-expression and perspectives you can bring to our global community. Our recruitment team is looking forward to meeting you.


***Notice to Job Seekers Regarding Impersonation and Fraudulent Job Offers***

It has come to our attention that unauthorized individuals and entities are impersonating Milestone Technologies, Inc. on various job boards/portals, specifically Naukri.com and Linkedin.com


Please be advised of the following official Milestone Technologies recruitment policies:


Official Communication Channels

All legitimate email communications from our recruitment team will originate ONLY from the domains: @milestone.tech. We do not use generic email services (e.g. @gmail.com, @yahoo.com, @outlook.com) or unofficial third party messaging apps to conduct formal business.

No Recruitment Fees

Milestone Technologies never requests any form of payment, "security deposit", "laptop/equipment fee", or "processing fee" at any stage of the recruitment or onboarding process. Any request for money in exchange for an interview or job offer is a scam.

4458671529.descriptionHtml:
About the Role

We are looking for a Full Stack Engineer with a backend focus, building services in Java and Spring Boot alongside an Angular frontend. This person is comfortable moving database-centric designs toward domain-driven structures and building RESTful APIs with clean, modern patterns. Strong SQL and relational database skills are essential.


What you will do

  • Spend the majority of your time (approx. 70-80%) designing and implementing robust backend services using Java and Spring Boot.
  • Build and maintain the supporting Angular frontend, ensuring a seamless connection between the UI and your backend logic.
  • Lead the transition from traditional database-centric designs toward a domain-driven structure (DDD).
  • Architect RESTful APIs that prioritize proper HTTP verbs and clean, scalable patterns over legacy RPC styles.
  • Work within cross-functional squads to deliver high-quality features while maintaining the "cohesive and proactive" spirit of the team.


Must haves

  • Advanced proficiency in Java (Spring Boot) and a solid working knowledge of Angular, of at least 3 years.
  • A strong grasp of Object-Oriented Design (OOD) and software design patterns.
  • Deep experience building and consuming RESTful services with a clear understanding of standard API protocols.
  • Experience working with relational databases (PostgreSQL, Oracle) and JPA/Hibernate. Candidates must have robust transactional database experience (Oracle, Postgres), strong SQL skills to navigate and optimize very complex SQL in KALC, and a thorough understanding of enterprise-level, high-transactional platforms. Lacking this specific database proficiency will be a direct reason for rejection.
  • A passion for server-side logic, performance, and architecture.
  • Upper-intermediate English level.


Nice to haves

  • Experience working with spec-driven development or related (AI-Driven Software Development Life Cycle).
  • Previous experience in the Loyalty or Fintech sectors.
  • Experience with cloud platforms (AWS or Azure) and containerization (Docker).
  • Knowledge of CI/CD pipelines (Jenkins, GitLab CI).
  • Experience refactoring legacy structures into modern, domain-driven architectures.


Perks and Benefits

  • Remote work & Local connection: Work where you feel most productive and connect with your team in periodic meet-ups to strengthen your network and connect with other top experts.
  • Legal presence in India: We ensure full local compliance with a structured, secure work environment tailored to Indian regulations.
  • Competitive Compensation in INR: Fair compensation in INR with dedicated budgets for your personal growth, education, and wellness.
  • Innovative Projects: Leverage the latest tech and create cutting-edge solutions for world-recognized clients and the hottest startups.

Backend Java Engineer (Java, Springboot & Kafka)

Engagement (Support-heavy, 70% Support and 30% Development)

Shift Timings: Morning Shift (9:00 AM to 6:00 PM) and Afternoon Shift (3:00 PM to 12:00 AM)

Years of Experience - 4 to 7 years (Mid Level)

Roles Open - 2 in the morning shift and 2 in the afternoon shift

Employment: Full-time employment with Samay India

Location: Remote (India)

On-call: Participation in a shared on-call rotation is required.

Availability: Preferring candidates who can join within 30 days or less.


Job Description


We are looking for hands-on Java backend engineers to join our Sustainment & Enhancement Squad. This role focuses on supporting, maintaining, and enhancing integrations with Oracle Retail Cloud MFCS.


The ideal candidate will have a strong development background along with production support experience. You should be comfortable troubleshooting issues across multiple services, identifying root causes, implementing permanent fixes, and working with senior engineers when issues require further escalation.


This role is suited to someone who understands how backend services communicate across systems and can effectively debug production issues while contributing to ongoing development and system improvements.


What You Will Do


- Develop a good understanding of Oracle Retail Cloud MFCS, its APIs, integration points, and the upstream and downstream services that interact with it.

- Monitor, troubleshoot, and support integrations with Oracle Retail Cloud MFCS and related backend services.

- Analyze application logs, database queries, API responses, Kafka events, and other system information to identify and resolve production issues.

- Troubleshoot issues across multiple services and identify whether the problem originates within the application, the database, the integration layer, or an external downstream system.

- Participate in production incident resolution, perform root cause analysis, and implement permanent fixes to prevent recurring issues.

- Maintain and enhance existing Java and Spring Boot applications, including bug fixes, minor enhancements, and performance improvements.

- Develop and maintain unit and integration tests and contribute to testing strategies that help identify issues before they reach production.

- Follow and contribute to coding standards, code review practices, monitoring, documentation, and other engineering best practices.

- Work closely with L3 and Lead engineers and other teams when issues require deeper technical investigation or architectural changes.

- Participate in on-call support and ensure production issues are communicated, tracked and escalated appropriately.


What You Will Bring


- 4 to 6 years of experience in Java backend development and production support.

- Strong hands-on experience with Java and Spring Boot.

- Strong hands-on production experience with Kafka, including real-time streaming and event-driven flows.

- Good understanding of REST APIs, service-to-service communication, and distributed backend systems.

- Strong SQL and relational database knowledge.

- Experience debugging and resolving production issues in backend applications.

- Good understanding of application logs, monitoring, debugging, and root cause analysis.

- Good understanding of integration patterns and troubleshooting issues across multiple services.

- Good understanding of unit testing and integration testing practices.

- Ability to work independently on L2 issues while knowing when and how to escalate complex issues.

- Willingness to participate in a shared on-call rotation.

- Understanding of cloud platforms and DevOps practices is good to have.


What Sets This Role Apart


We are looking for someone who has the fire and zeal to learn and deliver more, someone who is not limited to resolving tickets, but is able and interested to understand why an issue occurred and how to prevent it from happening again.

Senior Full Stack Developer


(Java, Spring Boot, React / Angular)

Experience: 8 – 12 Years

Company: Queberry Technologies

Location: India- Kochi

Primary Domain: Backend, Microservices & Cloud Secondary Focus: Frontend Integration (Full Stack)


Ownership & Ownership Mindset Requirement


We are seeking a proactive technical professional who acts as a true owner of their deliverables. In this role, you will hold end-to-end accountability for designing, building, deploying, and maintaining high-performance microservices. You are expected to take complete responsibility for architectural clarity, code quality, automated testing, system resilience, and cloud operations.


Role Overview


As an Associate Full Stack Engineer (Backend/Cloud Focus), you will serve as a core technical driver for projects backend engine while remaining cross-functional across the entire stack. You will architect robust RESTful APIs, manage cloud services, optimize streaming data workflows, and ensure seamless delivery from development through production.


Key Responsibilities


· Core Backend Development: Design, build, and maintain scalable, secure, and production-ready microservices using Java 17+, Spring Boot, Spring Cloud, and Hibernate/JPA.

· Cloud & Infrastructure: Deploy and manage containerized applications using Docker, Kubernetes, and AWS/ Azure cloud services. Implement CI/CD pipelines and automated infrastructure workflows.

· Data Management & Persistence: Optimize database interactions across relational databases (PostgreSQL/ Oracle) and NoSQL stores. Implement effective caching strategies (Redis) and asynchronous messaging queues (Kafka/RabbitMQ).

· Cross-Functional Full-Stack Integration: Collaborate closely with frontend teams to define clean API contracts, OpenAPI/Swagger specifications, and integrate frontend components (Angular/TypeScript) whenever end-to-end feature delivery requires cross-functional hands-on contribution.

· System Reliability & Ownership: Take full accountability for monitoring, bug resolution, operational performance, unit/integration testing (JUnit, Mockito), and code quality reviews.

Required Technical Qualifications & Experience

· Experience: 7 to 12 years of hands-on software development experience with a track record of owning backend systems.

· Java & Spring Ecosystem: Deep proficiency in Java (Java 11/17+), Spring Boot, Spring Security, Spring Data JPA, and RESTful API engineering.

· Cloud & DevOps: Hands-on experience with Docker, Kubernetes, AWS/Azure core infrastructure, and CI/CD pipelines (GitLab CI / Jenkins / GitHub Actions).

· Databases & Messaging: Strong command of SQL, database optimization, ORM tools, and event-driven architecture using Kafka or RabbitMQ.

· Full Stack Aptitude: Working knowledge of modern frontend frameworks (Angular, TypeScript) and Web Sockets for real-time user-facing features.


Core Competencies & Mindset


Ownership & Responsibility: Demonstrates a "buck stops with me" attitude toward system stability, code reliability, and timely feature completion.

Problem-Solving: Strong analytical skills to diagnose complex concurrency, performance bottlenecks, and distributed cloud issues.

Cross-Functional Collaboration: Excellent communication skills to work seamlessly across architects, QA engineers, and frontend specialists.


Work Location: In person

Salary : INR 9-12 LPA

What you'll do...

The Media ETL / Data Engineer is responsible for developing, maintaining, and monitoring marketing data pipelines that support enterprise media reporting, measurement, attribution, and optimization.

This role focuses on ensuring accurate and timely ingestion, transformation, validation, and delivery of media data across internal reporting and analytics platforms.

Key Responsibilities

Media Data Integration

  • Design and maintain pipelines that ingest data from media, advertising, and marketing

platforms.

  • Integrate data from:
  • Google Ads
  • DV360
  • CM360
  • Meta/Facebook Ads
  • TikTok Ads
  • LinkedIn Ads
  • Amazon Advertising
  • Programmatic DSPs
  • CRM/CDP platforms
  • Standardize campaign taxonomy, naming conventions, and metadata across channels.

Data Engineering

  • Build and maintain media data ingestion pipelines from advertising platforms and

agency data sources.

  • Develop automated ETL/ELT workflows and data transformation processes.
  • Support API integrations and data acquisition frameworks.
  • Create scalable data architecture supporting marketing reporting needs.
  • Validate media data accuracy and completeness.
  • Develop reconciliation and exception-reporting processes.
  • Investigate discrepancies between source systems and reporting outputs.
  • Support governance standards and campaign taxonomy requirements.

Marketing Analytics & Measurement

  • Enable reporting for:
  • Campaign performance
  • Customer acquisition
  • Attribution
  • Media Mix Modeling (MMM)
  • Return on Ad Spend (ROAS)
  • Customer Lifetime Value (CLV)
  • Build datasets supporting audience segmentation and activation.
  • Support experimentation and incrementality testing initiatives.
  • Create reporting-ready datasets supporting measurement and analytics initiatives.
  • Support attribution and optimization reporting requirements.
  • Improve performance of reporting and analytics data structures.
  • Partner with analytics teams to resolve reporting issues

What you'll bring to the team...

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with digital media and advertising datasets.
  • Understanding of attribution modeling and marketing measurement.
  • Experience with Customer Data Platforms (CDPs).
  • Knowledge of identity resolution and audience management.
  • Experience supporting marketing and advertising stakeholders.
  • Familiarity with AI-driven marketing analytics.
  • Experience with CM360, DV360, Google Ads, Meta, Amazon Ads, or similar platforms.
  • Experience supporting marketing analytics and measurement solutions.
  • Adobe Experience Platform exposure.
  • Data modeling experience.
  • Experience working with large-scale reporting environments.

Required Qualifications

  • 5+ years of data engineering or ETL development experience.
  • Advanced SQL skills.
  • Python development experience

CloudEagle.ai is an AI-powered platform for SaaS Management, AI Governance, and Identity Governance & Administration (IGA) that gives enterprises a single control center to discover, secure, govern, and optimize their entire SaaS and AI ecosystem. The platform helps organizations enforce AI usage controls, govern both human and non-human identities, and streamline IT and security operations without disrupting existing tools or workflows.

Trusted by companies like RingCentral, Automation Anywhere, Shiji, and Rec Room, CloudEagle enables enterprises to save 10–30% on software spend while securely managing hundreds of SaaS and AI applications at scale.

Recognized by analyst firms such as Gartner, GigaOm, and KuppingerCole for its AI/ML-driven innovation in SaaS and AI governance, CloudEagle offers 500+ direct integrations that help organizations eliminate shadow SaaS and AI, enforce AI governance policies, optimize access through intelligent identity governance, and secure non-human identities to reduce operational and security risk. (Website)


Location- Permanent work from home


Job Brief

We’re looking for a skilled Senior Java developer to join our team of creators who are consistently raising the bar for user experience. This person should be comfortable working independently as well as with a team in the design and development of mission-critical websites, applications, and layers of infrastructure.


Objectives of this role

  • Design, develop and maintain high-quality Java applications at the company.
  • Collaborate with teams in other departments to identify and prioritise requirements.
  • Conduct technical analysis to arrive at solutions and create technological artefacts in response to production issues.
  • Communicate regularly with stakeholders, project managers, quality assurance teams, and other developers regarding progress on long-term technology roadmap
  • Create and maintain workflows with teams to provide visibility and to ensure workload balance for consistent visual designs
  • Develop and oversee testing schedules in client server environment, addressing various browsers and devices to ensure that content is displayed as intended
  • Produce quality code, raising the bar for team performance and speed


Responsibilities

  • Write code and tests, build prototypes, resolve issues, and profile and analyze bottlenecks
  • Design robust APIs to support mobile and desktop clients
  • Manage and optimize scalable distributed systems in the cloud
  • Optimize web applications for performance and scalability
  • Develop automated tests to ensure business needs are met, and allow for regression testing.


Required skills and qualifications

  • A Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in software engineering, computer science, or a related field.
  • Proficient in Java, with a good knowledge of its ecosystems
  • Solid understanding of object-oriented programming
  • 3 to 12 years of demonstrable experience in Java development.
  • Strong knowledge of Java languages and web development frameworks like Spring, Hibernate, and Struts.
  • Expertise in developing web applications using front-end technologies (HTML, CSS, and JavaScript).
  • Working knowledge of database technologies (MySQL and Oracle).
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with organisational capabilities.
  • Experience with IT project management methodologies, such as Agile or Scrum.
  • Familiarity with cloud technologies (AWS, Azure, or Google Cloud).

4460010274.descriptionHtml:
Today, through BHN’s single global platform, businesses of all kinds can tap into the world’s largest network of branded payment solutions. BHN helps businesses grow revenue, increase loyalty, motivate and reward their teams, disburse funds and engage consumers. Branded payment solutions include the issuance and distribution of gift cards, egifts, corporate payouts and rewards, along with the technology to deliver these products in seamless, integrated ways. BHN’s network spans the globe with more than 400,000 consumer touchpoints. Learn more at BHN.com.


Overview


We are looking for a strong, product-minded Sr. Software Engineer to help build and evolve our Rewards and Redeem Platform. This role is ideal for an engineer who combines deep Java backend expertise with modern frontend and cloud engineering skills, and who is excited to work in an AI-accelerated software environment.

You will design, build, test, deploy, and operate scalable, secure, and resilient applications across a hybrid ecosystem of modern cloud-native services and legacy platforms. You will play a key role in modernizing core systems, improving developer productivity, and enabling intelligent, data-driven workflows for both internal teams and external partners.

This role requires hands-on engineering across backend services, APIs, frontend experiences, cloud infrastructure, observability, and software delivery. We are looking for someone who can move comfortably from architecture discussions to implementation details, and who can use modern engineering tools, including AI-assisted development, responsibly and effectively.


Responsibilities

  • Design, develop, test, deploy, and operate scalable applications and services for the Rewards and Redeem Platform
  • Own features and modules end to end, from technical design through production support and continuous improvement
  • Build and maintain secure, high-performance APIs and distributed services using Java and Spring Boot
  • Develop modern user experiences using Angular and contemporary frontend engineering practices
  • Contribute to modernization of legacy systems, including service decomposition, API-first design, and cloud migration patterns
  • Build highly available, observable, fault-tolerant systems on AWS using automation and infrastructure-as-code practices
  • Write clean, maintainable, testable code with strong unit, integration, and automation coverage
  • Participate in code reviews, design reviews, and technical discussions; raise the overall engineering bar through thoughtful feedback
  • Collaborate closely with product managers, architects, SRE/DevOps, and other stakeholders to deliver high-quality solutions
  • Use AI-enabled engineering tools to improve development velocity, code quality, documentation, testing, and operational efficiency while applying sound judgment, security, and review discipline
  • Support production systems through operational excellence practices, monitoring, alerting, incident response, and root cause analysis
  • Contribute to engineering standards, CI/CD improvements, and developer experience initiatives
  • Mentor junior engineers and help drive a strong culture of learning, ownership, and continuous improvement
  • Understand business goals, customer impact, and domain constraints when evaluating technical solutions and trade-offs


Qualifications


  • 5+ years of software engineering experience building enterprise or consumer-facing applications
  • Strong hands-on experience with Java and modern Spring frameworks, especially Spring Boot
  • Experience designing and building RESTful APIs and microservices in distributed environments
  • Solid understanding of object-oriented design, data structures, concurrency, and multithreaded application development
  • Strong experience with AWS services such as ECS/EKS, Lambda, API Gateway, S3, RDS, CloudWatch, IAM, and related cloud-native patterns
  • Experience with Angular and modern JavaScript/TypeScript frontend development
  • Strong experience with relational databases such as PostgreSQL and solid SQL/database design skills
  • Experience with CI/CD pipelines, automated testing, and secure software delivery practices
  • Familiarity with observability and production operations, including logging, metrics, tracing, alerting, and incident analysis
  • Experience working in Agile teams with strong collaboration and communication skills
  • Proven ability to troubleshoot complex technical issues across application, infrastructure, and integration layers

Preferred

  • Experience modernizing monolithic or legacy platforms into modular or service-oriented architectures
  • Experience with containerization and orchestration technologies such as Docker and Kubernetes
  • Experience with infrastructure as code tools such as Terraform or CloudFormation
  • Experience with event-driven architecture, messaging, or streaming technologies such as Kafka or SQS/SNS
  • Experience with React in addition to Angular
  • Familiarity with secure coding, identity and access patterns, API security, and compliance-sensitive systems
  • Exposure to AI-assisted software development tools and practices such as code generation, automated test creation, intelligent documentation, and developer copilots
  • Understanding of how to apply AI responsibly in engineering workflows, including review quality, data protection, and hallucination risk mitigation
  • Experience in payments, fintech, rewards, or other transaction-heavy domains

At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.

Position title - Senior Full Stack Engineer

Role Purpose

Design, develop, and maintain scalable, secure, and high-performing web applications across both frontend and backend domains. The role is expected to be highly hands-on, contributing directly to software delivery while driving engineering best practices, technical excellence, and modern development standards. The Senior Full Stack Engineer will work closely with product, design, architecture, platform, and AI teams to deliver cloud-native and AI-enabled digital products.

Key Responsibilities

  • Design, develop, test, and maintain modern web applications across frontend, backend, APIs, and data layers.
  • Lead the development of scalable, secure, and maintainable software solutions aligned with business and product requirements.
  • Build responsive and accessible user interfaces using modern frontend frameworks and component-based architectures.
  • Develop robust backend services, APIs, and microservices that support high-volume and mission-critical workloads.
  • Collaborate with product managers, UX designers, architects, and engineers to translate requirements into technical solutions.
  • Integrate external systems, third-party services, enterprise platforms, and cloud-native services.
  • Implement AI-enabled features, LLM integrations, workflow automation capabilities, and intelligent user experiences where applicable.
  • Contribute to software architecture decisions, technical design reviews, and engineering standards.
  • Establish and enforce coding standards, testing strategies, CI/CD practices, and quality assurance processes.
  • Troubleshoot complex production issues and optimize applications for performance, scalability, reliability, and security.
  • Mentor junior and mid-level engineers through code reviews, technical guidance, and knowledge sharing.
  • Contribute to reusable frameworks, shared libraries, and engineering accelerators to improve development efficiency.

Required Skills And Experience

  • Strong experience in full-stack software development with modern frontend and backend technologies.
  • Proficiency in frontend frameworks such as React, Angular, Vue.js, or equivalent modern JavaScript frameworks.
  • Expertise in JavaScript/TypeScript, HTML5, CSS3, and modern UI development practices.
  • Strong backend development experience using .NET, Java, Node.js, Python, or equivalent enterprise technologies.
  • Experience designing and developing RESTful APIs, GraphQL services, and microservice-based applications.
  • Solid understanding of software design patterns, object-oriented design principles, and clean architecture practices.
  • Experience with relational and NoSQL databases, including data modeling, performance tuning, and optimization.
  • Knowledge of cloud-native development on Azure, AWS, or Google Cloud Platform.
  • Experience with containerization, Kubernetes, CI/CD pipelines, DevOps tooling, and infrastructure automation.
  • Strong understanding of application security, authentication, authorization, API security, and secure coding practices.
  • Experience with automated testing frameworks, test-driven development, and quality engineering practices.
  • Knowledge of observability, logging, monitoring, and application performance management.

Preferred Skills

  • Experience building AI-enabled applications utilizing LLMs, AI agents, workflow orchestration, and RAG architectures.
  • Familiarity with Azure OpenAI, Azure AI Foundry, OpenAI, Anthropic, or similar AI platforms.
  • Experience with event-driven architectures, messaging platforms, and distributed systems.
  • Knowledge of design systems, accessibility standards, and modern UX engineering practices.
  • Experience working in Agile, DevOps, and product-centric development environments.
  • Exposure to enterprise-scale SaaS platforms and multi-tenant architectures.

Expected Profile

The candidate must be hands-on, delivery-oriented, and passionate about building high-quality software products. The expectation is not only to contribute code but also to drive technical excellence, mentor team members, and influence engineering best practices.

The ideal candidate combines strong frontend expertise, backend engineering depth, cloud-native development experience, and a product-focused mindset. They should be comfortable working across the entire software development lifecycle, from requirements analysis and technical design through implementation, deployment, optimization, and production support.

They should be capable of collaborating effectively with cross-functional teams while taking ownership of complex technical challenges and delivering scalable, reusable, and business-aligned solutions.

EY | Building a better working world

EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.

Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.

Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

4458947186.descriptionHtml:
ABOUT THE COMPANY

Waybeo is a conversation intelligence platform that helps enterprises turn every customer conversation into actionable business intelligence. Built on deep telecom expertise and AI-powered technology, Waybeo enables businesses to track, manage, and analyze customer conversations across their sales and marketing journeys. From call tracking and marketing attribution to call automation, speech analytics, and AI-driven conversation insights, Waybeo helps enterprises improve customer engagement, optimize operations, and drive measurable revenue growth.


Today, Waybeo powers communication intelligence across 100,000+ enterprise locations and serves 150+ enterprise customers across sectors including automotive, BFSI, retail, healthcare, and telecom.


Waybeo is part of the CareStack group, a global healthcare technology company. As an independent business within the group, Waybeo remains focused on building and scaling its expertise in cloud communications, telecom, and AI to help enterprises transform customer conversations into meaningful business outcomes.


ABOUT THE ROLE

We are transforming our core platform from a legacy, high-volume environment into a modern, highly scalable polyglot microservices ecosystem. We run a high-throughput platform processing massive daily transactions and are actively executing a multi-tenant migration strategy.

We are looking for a hands-on Senior / Lead Software Engineer to serve as our primary technical anchor on the office floor in Trivandrum. Working directly alongside our leadership team, you will translate strategic architectural visions into clean, maintainable code, mentor a growing team of junior engineers, enforce coding standards, and eliminate technical debt.

This is a hands-on execution role — you will be writing code, reviewing PRs, building automated pipelines, and driving daily engineering excellence in close alignment with technical leadership.


KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Tactical Execution & Ownership: Take end-to-end operational ownership of core platform modules — code quality, maintainability, performance, and clear system documentation.
  • Migration & Refactoring: Drive the hands-on transition of legacy client setups into our modern microservices ecosystem (TypeScript, Go, MySQL) following approved architectural blueprints and zero-downtime data migration strategies.
  • Standards & Rigor: Eliminate anti-patterns and hacks. Enforce automated testing (unit/integration), strict code reviews, CI/CD pipelines, and proper observability across the team.
  • In-Office Mentorship: Pair-program with and guide junior engineers daily to level up their debugging skills, design pattern usage, and code hygiene.
  • Documentation & Async Sync: Maintain detailed system architecture diagrams, API specs, and Architecture Decision Records (ADRs) to enable smooth asynchronous alignment with remote executive leadership.
  • Floor Anchor: Serve as the daily technical lead and primary go-to person on the office floor, keeping team velocity high while coordinating closely with leadership on key technical decisions.


REQUIRED QUALIFICATION

  • 5+ years of hands-on experience building, scaling, and maintaining backend systems in production environments.
  • Strong proficiency in Node.js / TypeScript and/or Go.
  • Deep expertise in relational databases (MySQL), schema design, index optimization, and safe, zero-downtime data migration techniques.
  • Demonstrated understanding of microservices architecture, design patterns, clean architecture, and API design (REST / gRPC).
  • Hands-on mindset toward automated testing (unit, integration, E2E) and modern CI/CD pipelines.
  • Excellent written communication, with a habits-first approach to documentation and asynchronous updates.
  • Proven ability to mentor and guide junior developers effectively in an office setting.


NICE TO HAVE

  • High-throughput or real-time event platforms (Kafka, SQS, WebSockets).
  • Prior participation in a monolith-to-microservices migration.
  • Cloud data warehousing or analytics pipelines (BigQuery, Dataform).


WHY JOIN US

  • Direct Impact: Play a pivotal role in transforming a high-volume platform and building a disciplined engineering culture.
  • Complex Challenges: High-volume, real-time distributed systems where performance, correctness and uptime matter.
  • Leadership Partner: Work in tight collaboration with executive leadership, bridging architecture with ground-level execution.

4462104362.descriptionHtml:
About The Company

Textellent, Inc. is a pioneering technology company dedicated to transforming business communication through innovative SMS marketing automation solutions. Our platform seamlessly integrates with various Customer Relationship Management (CRM) systems to enable personalized messaging campaigns, intelligent appointment scheduling, and AI-powered engagement strategies. With a focus on enhancing customer interactions and driving business growth, we serve a diverse range of clients across multiple industries. Our commitment to innovation, quality, and customer success has established us as a leader in the SMS marketing space. We foster a collaborative, inclusive, and forward-thinking work environment that values continuous learning and technological advancement.

About The Role

We are seeking an experienced Backend Developer to join our fully remote team at Textellent, Inc. This role is pivotal in driving our technological innovation, especially in leveraging AI-driven tools to enhance development workflows. The ideal candidate will be responsible for designing, developing, and maintaining scalable backend systems that support our SMS marketing automation platform. You will work closely with cross-functional teams to build high-performance APIs, optimize database performance, and deploy applications on cloud infrastructure. This position offers a unique opportunity to contribute to a cutting-edge product while utilizing AI-assisted development tools to accelerate delivery and improve code quality. As a key member of our team, you will help shape the future of our platform and contribute to our mission of redefining business communication.

Qualifications

The ideal candidate will have 4 to 7 years of experience in backend development, with a strong proficiency in Java, Spring Boot, SQL, and AWS cloud services. Experience with deploying and managing applications on AWS (including EC2, S3, RDS, SNS, SQS) is essential. Familiarity or interest in AI-based development tools such as GitHub Copilot, Claude Code, Cursor, or Lovable is highly desirable. Candidates should demonstrate excellent communication skills, problem-solving abilities, and a proven track record of working effectively in remote teams. A background in designing scalable backend architectures and optimizing database systems will be considered a strong advantage. We value candidates who are passionate about continuous learning, innovation, and leveraging emerging technologies to improve development processes.

Responsibilities

  • Develop, implement, and maintain robust backend functionalities using Java and Spring Boot frameworks to support our SMS marketing automation platform.
  • Design, optimize, and manage relational databases with SQL to ensure efficient data storage and retrieval.
  • Deploy, monitor, and manage cloud-based applications on AWS services such as EC2, S3, RDS, SNS, and SQS to ensure high availability and scalability.
  • Implement continuous integration and continuous deployment (CI/CD) pipelines utilizing tools like GitHub and Jenkins to streamline development workflows.
  • Leverage AI-assisted development tools like GitHub Copilot, Claude Code, Cursor, and Lovable to accelerate coding, testing, and deployment processes.
  • Collaborate effectively with remote cross-functional teams, including product managers, front-end developers, and QA engineers, to deliver impactful features on schedule.
  • Participate in code reviews, documentation, and knowledge sharing to maintain high code quality and team cohesion.
  • Stay updated with the latest industry trends and emerging technologies to continuously improve our platform and development practices.

Benefits

  • Work fully remotely with flexible working hours to promote work-life balance.
  • Competitive compensation package aligned with your skills and experience.
  • Opportunity to be part of a forward-thinking company that embraces AI, automation, and innovation.
  • Access to professional development resources and ongoing learning opportunities.
  • Supportive, collaborative team environment where your contributions are valued and recognized.
  • Paid time off (PTO) and holidays to ensure you have time to recharge and enjoy personal pursuits.
  • Long-term career growth opportunities within a company committed to employee success and retention.

Equal Opportunity

Textellent, Inc. is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. We do not discriminate based on race, ethnicity, gender, age, sexual orientation, disability, or any other protected characteristic. We believe that diverse perspectives and experiences drive innovation and excellence, and we are dedicated to fostering a workplace where everyone can thrive and contribute to our shared success.

4459917179.descriptionHtml:
Job Title: Java Full Stack Developer

Experience: 4+ Years

Location: Remote

Shift Timing: 7:30 PM IST – 4:30 AM IST (Night Shift)

Employment Type: Full Time/Contract


Responsibilities

  • Design and develop RESTful microservices and event-driven applications using Spring Boot 3 and JDK 21, including Virtual Threads, HttpClient, Records, Optional, and Pattern Matching.
  • Migrate/refactor applications to JDK 21 & Spring Boot 3, including dependency upgrades and deprecated API cleanup.
  • Implement Drools Rule Engine and application observability using Micrometer, distributed tracing, structured logging, health checks, and Actuator.
  • Develop Kafka and RabbitMQ producers/consumers with retry, dead-letter, idempotency, offset management, and Saga/event-driven workflows.
  • Build optimized Dockerfiles/multi-stage builds and Kubernetes manifests; troubleshoot pod crashes, OOMKills, JVM heap, resource, and networking issues.
  • Develop GitLab CI/CD pipelines for build, testing, SonarQube, SAST, dependency scanning, Docker image build/push, and Kubernetes deployment; manage runners, secrets, and variables.
  • Design Oracle schemas and develop SQL/PL/SQL, including query/index tuning and connection-pool configuration.
  • Develop lightweight Python/FastAPI services and perform log, metrics, and data validation analysis.
  • Ensure code quality using SonarQube, Checkstyle, SpotBugs, and PR gates; handle production troubleshooting, incident response, RCA, and postmortems.


Skills

  • Strong expertise in Java 21/JDK 21 and Spring Boot 3, with hands-on experience developing RESTful microservices.
  • Strong understanding of microservices and event-driven architecture, including Saga patterns and asynchronous workflows.
  • Hands-on experience with Kafka and RabbitMQ, including producers/consumers, retry, dead-letter queues, idempotency, offset management, and consumer lag.
  • Proficiency in implementing Drools Rule Engine and developing rule-based application frameworks.
  • Strong experience with Docker and Kubernetes, including Dockerfiles, multi-stage builds, Kubernetes manifests, troubleshooting, and containerized deployments.
  • Hands-on experience with GitLab CI/CD, GitLab runners, automated testing, SonarQube, SAST, dependency scanning, and Kubernetes deployments.
  • Strong knowledge of Oracle, SQL, and PL/SQL, including schema design, query optimization, index tuning, and connection-pool configuration.
  • Experience developing lightweight microservices using Python and FastAPI and performing data validation and analysis.
  • Experience using SonarQube, Checkstyle, and SpotBugs to enforce code quality and maintain engineering standards.
  • Strong troubleshooting skills with hands-on experience in JVM performance, production support, incident response, root-cause analysis, and postmortems


If interested, Kindly share your resume at hr@runmapglobal.com

4459907119.descriptionHtml:
We are looking for a Senior Software Engineer to join us in developing and maintaining a product lifecycle platform built on Java, Angular, Kafka, and PostgreSQL.

This engagement follows an AI-native delivery model, with AI Ops and AI SDLC practices embedded from Day 1. This is an opportunity for an early-career engineer to work within a modern microservices architecture on a platform of genuine industrial scale — 1 million+ products, 100,000+ client submissions annually — supported by an experienced team.

Responsibilities

  • Contribute to the development and maintenance of a product lifecycle platform at industrial scale
  • Build and enhance features across the full stack using Java, Angular, and PostgreSQL
  • Design and implement microservices within a modern distributed architecture
  • Develop and integrate REST APIs to support reliable service communication
  • Work with Kafka for event-driven data flows and messaging
  • Follow AI-native delivery practices, including AI Ops and AI SDLC, from Day 1
  • Adhere to established engineering standards and CI/CD workflows
  • Support platform reliability for a 24/5 environment with 24/7 P1/P2 coverage
  • Collaborate with an experienced team, participating in code reviews and feedback cycles

Requirements

  • 5-9 years of experience in Java Full Stack development
  • Proficiency in Java 8+, Spring Boot, and REST API development
  • Expertise in building and maintaining microservices architectures
  • Skills in Angular JS for front-end development
  • Competency in PostgreSQL for relational data management
  • Understanding of service communication patterns and REST APIs
  • Flexibility to work within established engineering standards and CI/CD workflows
  • Capability to learn and adapt in a complex, fast-paced environment
  • Attention to detail, given the platform's 24/5 uptime and 24/7 P1/P2 coverage
  • Collaborative mindset, comfortable asking questions and acting on feedback

Nice to have

  • Exposure to Kafka and Elasticsearch
  • Familiarity with hexagonal or microservices architecture patterns
  • Experience contributing to a team with defined code review and testing practices
